summary: Static technical re-audit of the on-disk (uncommitted-changes-included) state. expand-md.js output is byte-identical to source — zero {{prompt:<key>}} markers, zero fenced prompt blocks, zero [Skill: name] references, zero specific Claude Code/Desktop/Cowork capability assertions in body. So check_prompts.md is wholly N/A by absence of subject matter, and the large majority of check_platform_and_boundaries.md is N/A for the same reason. Live technical surface is the backing block's Sources ledger: three claims (500K-lines demo — maintainer-attested, due:none; Agentics Helsinki meetup — practitioner direct, checked 2026-05-25, dated-historical carve-out; Horthy wsff.md — practitioner direct/vendor venue, checked 2026-07-29, due 2027-01-29). Re-verified both URL-bearing sources live (curl 200 on both; WebFetch on wsff.md confirms the argument attributed to Horthy is actually his — 'the cost function of bad architecture is measured in weeks... RL can run millions of loops' against tests that answer in seconds — matching the body's paraphrase, correctly presented as argument-summary not verbatim quote). The prior-cycle '[convergent]' mislabel finding on the million-lines close (flagged in an earlier technical instance for this file) is resolved on-disk: the Flagged section now records it was retired to 'vision' with no source owed, and the current Claims list carries it as vision/none-owed — no stray source-type tag remains to flag. No blocking findings.
